metadata.description: SageReasoning local plugin marketplace. Add it with `/plugin marketplace add ./harness/gate1-pre-decision` from the repo root (or the absolute path), then install explicitly with `/plugin install sage-gate1-pre-decision@sagereasoning` — adding a marketplace does NOT auto-install (PR12).

plugins.name: sage-gate1-pre-decision
plugins.description: Gate 1 pre-decision examination harness — frames the top-level task (UserPromptSubmit) and each delegated subagent (PreToolUse-on-Agent) before the agent reasons, via SageReasoning /api/reason.
